Sign-in handoff and files from bots.

## Install

Download **`Hermes-Bots-Setup-1.4.0.exe`** below and run it. It installs over 1.x and keeps your settings and chats.

- **Not code-signed.** Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- No auto-update: install a newer `Hermes-Bots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.

## New

### Sign-in handoff
- When a bot hits a login, 2FA, captcha or anything only you can do on its computer, it hands you the screen (`request_user_help`). A card in its 1:1 chat opens its computer in the large view with you in control (starting it first if it's off).
- A banner above the screen shows what to do, with **Done** and **Can't do it**. Either one gives the screen back and tells the bot. Groups only get a note pointing to the 1:1 chat.

### Files from bots
- Bots send charts, images and documents as attachments (`send_file`), in 1:1 chats and groups.
- Images show inline (click to enlarge); short videos and audio play inline; other files get **Download** (Save dialog) and **Open** (default app).
- Files are fetched from Hermes only when needed. Paths are checked: absolute, no credential files, up to 50 MB.

## Fixed

- Ctrl+V in the app's own fields while the large Computer view is open (like the handoff banner's reason box) now pastes there instead of into the bot's desktop. Paste goes to the remote only while the remote screen has focus.

## Notes

- Bots pick up the new tools when Hermes reloads the app's tool list (a new chat session, or reconnecting the app).
- Needs a Hermes with the managed-files API (`/api/files`), the same one the shared folder uses.
